coastal.title: Vets warn pet owners after rabies detected in 2 bats in B.C.
coastal.description: A Whistler veterinarian says the positive cases come alongside a surge in overall bat encounters in the Sea-to-Sky region this year, with her clinic handling six bat-pet run-ins on Tuesday alone.

kamloops.title: Summerland businesses face another blow as water advisory keeps doors closed
kamloops.description: Summerland is trying to get back on its feet after the Bald Range wildfire, but for some local businesses, the disruption is far from over.

kamloops.title: High-risk sex offender facing new charges in Langley after being released again
kamloops.description: Michael Wayne Carpenter is currently on a long-term supervision order for sexual assault with a weapon, forcible confinement and uttering threats.

kamloops.title: Could ‘Lucky’ found in Netherlands be a Vancouver man missing since 1994?
kamloops.description: The man, who has been nicknamed 'Lucky,' collapsed on a street in Amsterdam on May 10, 2023. It was determined after he received medical care that he was left with aphasia.
